chapter.title: Debugging support
chapter.para: These requirements apply to the parts of JetOS that are there to debug and to monitor a module. The GDB server, the monitor and the instrumentation are present only in a kernel that is built with them.

section.para: JetOS shall, when it is built with the GDB server, accept requests of the GDB remote serial protocol over the debug console, with checksums and acknowledgments, in the time slots of the schedule that are GDB slots and, if it is configured to wait for GDB, at the start of the module before the partitions start.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A debugger can be connected to a module that is running in a defined way.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

section.para: JetOS shall present to the debugger the kernel as process 1, whose threads are the kernel-only partitions, and each user partition as a process of its own, whose threads are the processes of the partition and an idle thread for the time when no process can run.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The debugger sees the module as ARINC 653 partitions and processes.

formalpara.title: Verification
formalpara.para: Test.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A debugger shows and changes the state of the module.

formalpara.para: Test.
